newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian premier insists Pol Pot still alive.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian premier insists Pol Pot still alive.

text.p: Cambodia's first prime minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh insisted on Monday that Khmer Rouge guerrilla chief Pol Pot was still alive and said those saying he was dead were afraid of what he might say in court.

The prince's top military adviser, deputy chief of general staff Niek Bun Chhay, said on Sunday he had seen Pol Pot earlier in the day in a north Cambodian guerrilla base where the rebel leader was being detained by his former comrades.
